<includeonly>{{#if:{{{1|}}}
	|<templatestyles src="Template:Template journal inline/styles.css" /><span class="tj-tape"><span class="tj-nc">&#124;</span>{{#invoke:MultiReplace|main
		| plain = no
		| 1 = {{{1|}}}
		| 2 = ^([^:].-)%s*:%s*(.*)$
		| 3 = <span class{{=}}"tj-an">%1</span><span class{{=}}"tj-nc">&#61;</span><span class{{=}}"tj-ac">%2</span>
		| 4 = ^[^:]+$
		| 5 = <span class{{=}}"tj-ac">%0</span>
		| 6 = ^:%s*(.*)$
		| 7 = <span class{{=}}"tj-nc">&#61;</span><span class{{=}}"tj-ac">%1</span>
	}}</span>
	|{{Error|Error: Missing parameter}}
}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{documentation}}</noinclude>
